tone.target: saturated British psychedelic lead with wah-like bite and roomy space
tone.profile: saturated British psychedelic lead with wah-like bite and roomy space
tone.summary: A saturated, fuzzy signal chain utilizing a classic UK amp model (UK 45) combined with a wah filter for psychedelic lead tones, finished with room ambience.
corrections: keep the lead tone raw and psych

blocks.purpose: Clean up hum and noise inherent in fuzz/vintage tones.
Provide initial grit and boost the signal into the fuzz stage.
blocks.gap: The Green OD is used here as a general dirt source, simulating an early tube preamp push before the main fuzz/amp section.

blocks.purpose: Achieve the required high-level fuzz/psychedelic saturation (Fuzz Face style).
blocks.gap: The 'Fuzz' model is chosen to emulate classic, aggressive fuzz tones.

blocks.purpose: Add the required wah-like tonal sweep and bite for lead lines.
Boost upper-mids and treble to cut through the fuzz while maintaining vintage warmth.
blocks.gap: Used for surgical EQ shaping, avoiding mid-scooping.

blocks.purpose: Provide the core vintage British amp tone (Plexi/Marshall feel).
Ground the tone in a classic British cabinet sound.
Add the required 'roomy space' and vintage ambience.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet simulation to better capture the raw, open sound of a vintage British combo amp.

proposals.reason: Enhance the 'roomy' and open sound required for psychedelic rock, moving beyond a standard cabinet emulation.
